title: Build Dashboard
content:
This dashboard is built on node / react / vite

Navigate to dashboard root directory `~/Projects/Tools/Charon/charon/gateway/static/dashboard_v2`
- The vite.config.ts file is set up for running the production build of the dashboard. Attempting to run the live view requires modifications to this file.

Building a new version of the dashboard:
- From the root directory, run 
```bash
npm run build
```
